title: Keep recipe validation in the library and evolution campaigns in the host
narrative: MechaHarness validates, executes, versions, and safety-gates recipes; June (or another host) owns workload selection, experiment budgets, evaluation campaigns, and promotion policy. Docs already split ownership; named evolution campaign hooks remain a delta. Tracks MH-SR-09[^insp-sr-09].
implementation: Config/DI graph_template_classes and recipe registry; ownership prose in recipes-and-decision-plane and FineEnvs/June maps. Desired: explicit host hooks for evolution campaigns and promotion policy without moving validation into the host.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-SR-09, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
